'''Black_wraith MWYHL/SYIC''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Black_wraith]]
* '''Published:''' 22 January 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 MWYHL Black wraith LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Yoda (V) (Virtual Set 5), Son Of Skywalker (V) (Virtual Set 5), Rayc Ryjerd (V) (Virtual Set 5), 2-1B (Too-Onebee) (V) (Virtual Set 4), Bionic Hand (V) (Virtual Set 6), Flash Of Insight (V) (Virtual Set 5), Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) (Virtual Set 1), Keep Your Eyes Open (V) (Virtual Set 6), R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Virtual Set 3), Red 5 (V) (Virtual Set 3): not in GEMP)

== Introduction ==

Asteroids and Luke, what a combination.

== Notes ==

* Jedi Tests posted as 'Tests: 1-6'; dested by number to Great Warrior, A Jedi's Strength, Domain Of Evil, Size Matters Not, It Is The Future You See, You Must Confront Vader (strategy describes Test 6 against a Vader-less opponent).
* Original-era (V): Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) (VS1); R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) and Red 5 (V) (VS3); 2-1B (Too-Onebee) (V) (VS4); Yoda (V), Son Of Skywalker (V), Rayc Ryjerd (V) and Flash Of Insight (V) (VS5); Bionic Hand (V) and Keep Your Eyes Open (V) (VS6, the latest legal; VS4 also existed).
* Posted 'Flash (v)' dested Flash Of Insight (V), the only 'Flash' card; 'Son of flystalker (v)' Son Of Skywalker (V); 'HC and the F' Han, Chewie, And The Falcon.
* Posted 'Wise advice' in the starting cards dested the Special Edition Effect, not the Reflections III shield.
* Sites posted as 'Dag- bog clearing' and ditto marks dested to the Dagobah sites; 'Big One' dested the Big One sector.

== Strategy ==

Basically I get luke and short green dude on Dag, and start Luke’s training. While that’s going on wedge, Han, Chewie and Hobbie play force drains and rycar’s run. Once Luke finishes his training, he helps out Obi and Qui force drain at any opponents sites. Gift help them beat down by adding 2 destinies.  Basically drain, and Rycar run, and have fun. Its especially fun to play a Test 6 when your opponent dosen’t have a Vader, because of the 2 lost force a turn, I love to watch annoyance creep onto my opponents face.

Any way tell me what you think.
